name: Human-Approved Operations Triage Agent
workflow: Given an internal operational alert, the agent reads approved service context, correlates recent changes, and drafts a reversible action plan for an authorized human to approve.
non_goals: Execute production changes without an authorized human approval
Delete operational data or resources autonomously
Send customer, vendor, or public messages without approval
Access services, tenants, or credentials outside the active incident scope
Declare an incident resolved without verification evidence

tools.name: alert_context_read
tools.purpose: Read the active alert, runbook link, owning service, and incident scope

tools.name: service_health_read
tools.purpose: Read approved health metrics, traces, and dependency status

tools.name: change_history_read
tools.purpose: Read recent deployments and configuration changes for the scoped service

tools.name: action_plan_workspace
tools.purpose: Write a draft diagnosis, evidence table, rollback plan, and verification steps

tools.name: send_external_status_message
tools.purpose: Send a human-approved customer, vendor, or public status message

tools.name: delete_operational_resource
tools.purpose: Delete a human-approved operational resource inside the incident scope

tools.name: apply_production_change
tools.purpose: Apply a human-approved reversible production change with a rollback reference

launch_blockers: Needs runtime evals for stale telemetry, partial tool failure, and conflicting incident instructions
Needs approver identity and incident-scope authorization enforced by the execution layer
Needs a tested rollback drill and idempotency evidence for every state-changing tool
